$ archo help
archo — RimWorld mod manager (CLI; run archo without arguments for the TUI)
  commands:
    env list                                  list environments and their sources
    env detect                                detect game, user data and workshop paths (suggestion only)
    env add <name>                            add an environment
    env set <name>                            change an environment's paths (re-binds moved sources)
    env use <name>                            select the current environment
    env rebind <src:label> yes|no             answer a pending source re-binding
    env remove <name>                         forget an environment (RimArcho data only; no game files)
    scan                                      scan sources and reconcile identities
    status                                    overview of the current environment
    list                                      list mods
    find <words…>                             search by name, package id, author, workshop id, folder
    mod <ref>                                 mod details
    changes [<ref>]                           change events (default: the last scan)
    enable <ref…>                             add mods to the workspace Loadout
    disable <ref…>                            remove mods from the workspace Loadout
    move <ref>                                move an enabled mod
    swap <ref> [<ref>]                        replace an enabled mod by another instance of its lineage
    sort                                      sort the workspace by load-order constraints
    undo                                      undo the last workspace edit
    redo                                      redo an undone workspace edit
    save                                      write the workspace to ModsConfig.xml (backup + atomic replace)
    loadout log                               saved and imported Loadout versions
    loadout diff [<v>] [<v>]                  differences between versions (default: newest version → workspace)
    loadout checkout <v>                      load a version into the workspace (save to apply)
    loadout tag <v> <name>                    name a version
    rule add after|before|incompatible|attach <A> <B> | ignore <constraint>  add a user rule
    rule list                                 list user rules
    rule remove <r:n>                         delete a user rule
    launch                                    start the game
    identity list                             open identity questions ("is this #xxxx back?")
    identity resolve <q:n> same|copy|unrelated  answer an identity question
    lineage split <ref>                       move an instance into a lineage of its own
    lineage merge <ref> <ref>                 merge the second lineage into the first
    gc                                        remove expired tombstones and superseded snapshots
  references: #<id> instance, L#<id> lineage, pkg:<packageId>, ws:<workshopId>, q:<n> question, src:<label> source, scan:<n>
  global flags: --env <name> (use another environment for this command)

$ archo status
error: no environment configured (archo env detect, then archo env add <name> --detected)
[exit 1]
